llm_response.reason: The site mimics legitimate e-commerce (Lazada) but solely promotes online gambling (QQ228) with claims of easy winning and huge bonuses. All hyperlinks redirect to a single short link, a typical redirection scam tactic. There is excessive use of psychological triggers (exclusive winning, massive discounts, 24/7 chat), ambiguous contact info, no verifiable business credentials, and privacy-shielded WHOIS. The product lists are copied from famous e-commerce sites to create a false sense of legitimacy, and references to well-known brands are used without verification. These are all classic characteristics of online scam sites.
